verdict.rationale: Amplitude exposes HTTP APIs (event ingestion, Dashboard REST API, cohort and Experiment APIs) that explicitly support scripting/CI use ('Manage flags, experiments, and deployments from CI, scripts, or your own tools'), plus a documented OpenAPI spec and a Wizard CLI for instrumentation. However, most of the product (dashboards, session replay, visual editors) is UI-centric, so only a subset of functionality is truly headless-automatable.
